zh: 管理员每天要逐条调整几十个预约
en: appointment booking
the confirmation screen goes blank
bulk rescheduling by time slot
administrators adjust dozens of appointments one at a time every day

zh: 主管每周都要重新录入相同班次
en: staff scheduling
saved changes do not take effect
copying a whole weekly schedule
supervisors enter the same shifts every week

zh: 确认签收后状态仍显示待处理
配送员每晚要手工汇总各区域进度
en: delivery confirmation
confirmed packages still show as pending
a summary by delivery zone
couriers manually compile progress for each zone every night

zh: 提交后无法打开报名记录
团队每月要手工搭建相同的报名表
en: event registration
the registration record will not open after submission
copying event settings in one click
the team rebuilds the same form every month

zh: 上传凭证后弹出错误提示
财务只能逐笔核对同一项目的单据
en: expense submission
uploading a receipt produces an error
reviewing submissions by project in batches
finance has to review receipts for the same project individually

zh: 提交后记录列表一直不刷新
巡检人员每次都要浏览整栋楼的任务列表
en: facility inspections
the inspection list does not refresh after submission
filtering checks by floor
inspectors scroll through the entire building's tasks on every round

zh: 切换页面后选项被清空
审核人员一天要重复设置几十次
en: document review
selections disappear when switching pages
setting defaults per queue
reviewers repeat the same settings dozens of times a day

zh: 提交申请后未显示审批人
按团队保存常用设备列表
员工反复搜索同样的设备
en: equipment reservations
the approver is missing after a request is submitted
saving common equipment by team
employees repeatedly look up the same items

zh: 保存检测结果时返回错误
自动汇总同一设备的维修记录
工程师需要翻查多个页面才能了解历史
en: repair intake
saving a diagnostic result returns an error
a consolidated repair history per device
engineers need to search several pages for a device's history

zh: 站长每天都要手工拆分清单
en: dispatch handoff
the handoff checklist fails to load
exporting checklists by depot
depot managers split up the checklist manually every day

A: 旧单 SR-{ticket} 只影响一台设备。今天{area}再次出现{symptom}，五个站点都无法完成核心操作，备用入口也失败，影响正在扩大。
大家仍能打开{area}，但后台显示新记录正在被错误覆盖。已经确认六条数据丢失，仍有新写入受影响。
有人称这是{area}的改进建议。实际是发布后所有班组同时出现{symptom}，核心业务已中断，重试无效。
B: 支持同事已在一个试点账号复现{area}的{symptom}，只影响旧版本，改用网页端可以继续。
用户猜测和 SR-{ticket} 有关，但旧单只在批量操作时出现。现在{area}逐条处理时出现{symptom}，同事按录屏稳定复现，影响仅限一组。
用户把{area}提交为功能建议。核对原设计应能正常完成，实际出现{symptom}。只有单台设备复现，其他设备可用。
C: 现有{area}按设计运行。用户想要{feature}，因为{need}，每周都要额外花时间处理。
客户把{area}标记为严重问题。现场复核系统正常，他们希望增加{feature}，主要因为{need}。
团队建议在{area}支持{feature}。当前可以完成任务，但{need}。没有异常或失败记录。
D: 新录屏确认{area}仍出现{symptom}，同一版本和操作顺序与处理中 SR-{ticket} 完全一致，只新增一条证据。
有人担心{area}再次故障，研发确认只是 SR-{ticket} 的另一条反馈。同一触发条件、同一症状，影响范围未变化。
新工单描述{area}的{symptom}，与已确认的 SR-{ticket} 同根因。原单有负责人，影响仍限原先的一组用户。
E: 群里有人说{area}坏了，猜测和 SR-{ticket} 一样。只有转述，缺少操作步骤、具体症状和发生时间。
工单给{area}勾了最高优先级，正文只有‘急，弄不了’。没有出错环节、影响范围或截图。
用户说希望优化{area}。没有说明要完成的任务、遇到的困难或想实现什么结果。

A: SR-{ticket} previously affected one device. In {area}, {symptom} now happens at five sites and nobody can complete the core task. The backup path fails too.
People can still open {area}, but new records are being overwritten incorrectly. Six confirmed records have already been lost and the corruption is ongoing.
Someone filed this as an improvement to {area}. Since the release, every shift reports the same failure: {symptom}. The core task is blocked and retries do not help.
B: Support reproduced a problem with {area}: {symptom}. It affects one pilot account on an older version and the web client works.
The reporter mentions SR-{ticket}, but that ticket only happens in bulk mode. In {area}, {symptom} occurs when processing a single item. We reproduced it from the recording and it affects one team.
A customer called this a feature request. The current design for {area} should work, but {symptom}. We reproduced it on one device and the other devices are fine.
C: The current {area} flow works as designed. Users ask for {feature} because {need}. It costs the team time each week.
A customer marked {area} as a severe issue. The team verified that it works today. They want {feature} because {need}.
The team proposes {feature} for {area}. They can finish the task today, but {need}. There is no failed operation to reproduce.
D: A new recording shows that in {area}, {symptom}. The release and exact steps match open SR-{ticket}. This adds one more example and the impact is unchanged.
Support worried that {area} had broken again. Engineering confirmed the new report is another occurrence of SR-{ticket}, with the same trigger, symptom, and scope.
The new report says that in {area}, {symptom}. The owner confirmed it is the same cause as SR-{ticket}, still limited to the original group.
E: Someone in chat said {area} is broken and guessed it might be SR-{ticket}. We only have a forwarded message with no steps, symptoms, or time.
A ticket marks {area} as highest priority and says only 'urgent, cannot do it'. It gives no failure point, affected users, or screenshot.
A customer says {area} should be improved. There is no description of the task, what gets in the way, or the intended result.

A: 安全审计发现{area}的保密资料可以被陌生账号读到。界面没有提示，权限变更仍在扩散，已有异常访问记录。
D: 第两个客户也报告{area}出现{symptom}。当班人员对照截图和配置，确认原来的缺陷 SR-{ticket} 已覆盖，仍只在相同设置下发生。
E: 负责人只转来一句‘它又挂了，马上处理’，怀疑是{area}。没人知道用户点了什么，或是否还有其他人受影响。

A: An audit found that confidential records in {area} became accessible to unrelated accounts. The interface looks normal, but the access changes are spreading and the logs show unauthorized reads.
D: A second customer reports that in {area}, {symptom}. The on-call lead compared screenshots and settings and confirmed the open defect SR-{ticket} covers this report. It still occurs only under the original setting.
E: A lead forwarded 'it's broken again, fix immediately' and guessed it was {area}. Nobody knows what the customer clicked or whether any other user is affected.
